what: an edge flange on the side edge of an existing wall, meeting a flange on the base across the existing bend with a round corner relief (not supported yet: a flange on the side of another flange)
method: one valid closed body: a 120 x 90 base with a 30 mm wall on its y = 0 edge and a 20 mm flange on its x = 120 edge, plus a flange on the wall's side edge (x = 120) that mitres with it. The outer faces stand on the base's outline and the tallest wall is 30 high, so the bounding box is 120 x 90 x 30 (x 0..120, y 0..90, z 0..30)
